title: Senior Editorial Cover Illustrator
description:
Brightwell Editorial Studio is seeking a Senior Editorial Cover Illustrator to join our in-house creative team. The ideal candidate has 5+ years of experience producing cover art for major publishing houses and magazines. You will work directly with our editorial directors to develop visual concepts for book covers, magazine features, and branded editorial campaigns.

Responsibilities:
- Develop original cover illustration concepts from brief to final delivery
- Collaborate with art directors across multiple imprints
- Maintain consistent visual identity across editorial series
- Manage multiple concurrent deadlines in a fast-paced environment

About Brightwell Editorial Studio: We are a full-service editorial design and illustration studio serving mid-to-large publishing houses and magazine groups. Our client roster includes several imprints that compete directly in the literary fiction and narrative nonfiction space.

Note: Candidates currently under exclusivity or non-compete agreements with competing editorial studios should disclose this prior to interview.
